non_leisure_exclusion_policy.rationale: Cultural atlas leisure browse view must present places of leisure, heritage, and nature, while transit hubs and emergency services are accessible via specialized Map/Services views.

canonical_odia_naming.rule: Canonical Odia script name from localized_names.or is preserved and displayed alongside English title across PlaceCard and PlaceDetail.
canonical_odia_naming.search_inclusion: Search queries in Odia unicode script match against odiaName directly.
